name: grantlane
description: Milestone grant escrow — confidential scoring on Chainlink CRE, settlement on Arc, identity by World ID.

scripts.contracts:build: wsl -d Ubuntu -- bash -lc 'export PATH=$HOME/.foundry/bin:$PATH; cd contracts && forge build'
scripts.contracts:test: wsl -d Ubuntu -- bash -lc 'export PATH=$HOME/.foundry/bin:$PATH; cd contracts && forge test -vv'
scripts.workflow:typecheck: wsl -d Ubuntu -- bash -lc 'export PATH=$HOME/.bun/bin:$PATH; cd cre-workflow/grant-evaluation-workflow && bun x tsc --noEmit'
scripts.workflow:simulate: wsl -d Ubuntu -- bash -lc 'export PATH=$HOME/.local/bin:$HOME/.bun/bin:$PATH; cd cre-workflow && cre workflow simulate grant-evaluation-workflow --target staging-settings --http-payload ./grant-evaluation-workflow/simulation/milestone-approved.json'
scripts.workflow:build: wsl -d Ubuntu -- bash -lc 'export PATH=$HOME/.local/bin:$HOME/.bun/bin:$PATH; cd cre-workflow && cre workflow build grant-evaluation-workflow --target staging-settings'
scripts.workflow:broadcast: wsl -d Ubuntu -- bash -lc 'export PATH=$HOME/.local/bin:$HOME/.bun/bin:$PATH; cd cre-workflow && cre workflow simulate grant-evaluation-workflow --target staging-settings --http-payload ./grant-evaluation-workflow/simulation/milestone-approved.json --broadcast'
